headlines.snippet: It was cleared for publication: Sgt. Ron Yonatan Reitman and Sgt. Yuval Shai Suissa fell in a terrorist attack at the Yehuda Junction. Reitman, 23, from Ashkelon, and Suissa, 20, from Hod HaSharon, served in the Ari Battalion of the Rescue Brigade. Three additional fighters were wounded moderately and lightly. The IDF estimates that the terrorists planned a major attack against civilians, which was prevented thanks to the fighters' actions. The two terrorists were neutralized, and a foreign photographer is suspected of knowing about the attack in advance. Netanyahu ordered an immediate lockdown of Hebron and preparations for a full closure in Judea and Samaria.

The election results will determine how Israel will be treated in the continent's largest country.
